macro.title: What It Means For VWRA, Global Bonds, Gold & Bitcoin

reads.label: The regime is a hawkish real-rate shock on an energy supply shock, and in it diversification does not work.
reads.text: Global equities take the repricing through the discount rate. The bond sleeve hedges nothing while duration is what is being repriced; its 4.36 per cent yield is compensation for exactly the risk arriving. Gold behaves as the duration asset it is — a ten-year at 5.15 per cent is what competes with it, and gold lost.

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Track Pumps & The Bike Bench
stories.headline: Silca’s own engineer rates the $509 SuperPista gauge at 1.6 psi either way
stories.dek: Josh Poertner, Silca’s engineering chief, says the SuperPista Ultimate is least accurate at zero and at 160; OutdoorGearLab measured a $199 Silca seven psi out.

stories.headline: The Cornell bird archive began in 1929 and now holds 3.2 million recordings
stories.dek: Field recording captures the world’s existing sound; Bernie Krause says more than half his 5,000-hour archive is of places that no longer sound like that.

stories.headline: Sindh prices a road death at 700,000 rupees, Islamabad at 19 million
stories.dek: A Sindh gazette of 23 February bolted compulsory motor insurance onto the token-tax counter, and policies went from 11,200 in March to 452,515 on 13 November.

stories.kicker: The World · The Nationwide Ground Stop
stories.headline: The Federal Aviation Administration halted every US departure for four hours
stories.dek: Transport Secretary Sean Duffy blames a router installed at El Dorado, Arkansas, on 13 November; Hewlett Packard Enterprise says the device was a Juniper and did not fail.

stories.headline: Microsoft’s cloud failure cut Singapore government email for twenty-two hours
stories.dek: GovTech restored Outlook at 11pm on 13 November and blames a network capacity upgrade, not an attack; the tax authority, SingHealth and the police were among those cut off.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports its biggest quarter on Tuesday with Colette Kress as interim chief
stories.dek: Jensen Huang resigned on 12 November; two days earlier the independent directors hired the former prosecutor Joon H. Kim to investigate, and did not say into what.

stories.headline: Apple’s HomeView went on sale on Friday at S$399 in Singapore
stories.dek: The seven-inch countertop display recognises up to six faces, but Siri’s new intelligence ships as an English-only beta and no reviewer was allowed to test the recognition.

stories.headline: Petermann Bédat premiered its first chronograph in Singapore at CHF 180,000
stories.dek: The Reference 2914 is a 36.5mm platinum monopusher in twenty pieces, with dial plates from Kari Voutilainen’s Comblémine; SJX calls the price “aggressive”.

stories.headline: Ebenezer opened at $19 million, a million below Paramount’s own projection
stories.dek: Johnny Depp’s Dickens adaptation took $19,000,000 from 3,535 American cinemas over 13–15 November, on an A− CinemaScore and a 90 per cent audience score.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Food Marketing On Phones
stories.headline: A JAMA Pediatrics study put food adverts to young teenagers at 3,883 a year
stories.dek: Screen recordings from 1,011 American children, median age twelve, found 82.6 per cent of that marketing on social media and 30.4 per cent on TikTok alone.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The December Hike
stories.headline: A December Federal Reserve hike is fully priced, and every hedge failed at once
stories.dek: The ten-year Treasury yield rose 29 basis points in a week to 5.15 per cent; gold broke $4,000 to a thirteen-month low and bitcoin fell 19 per cent from 5 November.

stories.headline: Daily activity falls 7.8 minutes a year, a BMJ Public Health review finds
stories.dek: Runacres and colleagues pooled 151 studies in BMJ Public Health on 11 November; childhood step counts predicted adult ones with a correlation of minus 0.01.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Diana Krall At The Esplanade
stories.headline: Diana Krall plays the Esplanade Concert Hall on 24 and 25 November
stories.dek: Esplanade tickets run from $88 to $268 across six categories for a seventy-five-minute set with no interval, and the hall admits children from six.
